versions.content: To notify the upper layer about the termination of an active TP transmission on closing a socket connection within SoAd_MainFunction() , SoAd shall call <Up>_[SoAd][Tp]TxConfirmation() with parameter result set to (1) E_OK if disconnect is caused by SoAd_CloseSoCon() and all data was correctly transmitted, and (2) E_NOT_OK for any other cause.
